column4: Hurt unit survives and acts; a kill effect ignores defence anyway. The links are generic death-effect or survival matches; neither card changes the other.
Place Peni Parker in a lane; attach SP//dr to her; she now gives extra carry-over supply next round, which pays for a big unit deployed early. Without the attach she gives nothing.
Place a first-striking unit in the front row; a fight card makes it strike a chosen enemy, even a deeper one, and it kills before the enemy hits back. Enemy can only block by filling the front.
A striking unit that kills gets another action, but the sampled pairs are mostly equipment or cost links; the strike does not change when the kill fires.
Place a unit whose Place effect takes strength from an enemy front unit; take it back to hand and place it again: the Place fires again, shrinking the enemy for good. Redeploy costs supply.

column4: Place a guard unit in the front row beside a unit that gives its neighbours health when it dies; the enemy must hit the guard, and when the helper dies the guard grows tougher.
Place a unit whose supply grows when an enemy dies; use an outright kill on the enemy front unit: it dies regardless of defence and my carry-over rises, paying for the next deployment.
Deploy a unit that discards a card and returns itself to hand, then place it again; the discarded card acts from the pile (or is brought back), so each redeploy loops value.
Cast a spell that draws a card; a unit already on the board grows or gains from that spell. The draw replaces the spell's card, so spells chain cheaply.
A unit grows for each card I drew last round; cast a draw-2 spell, and at round end the unit stands bigger in its cell. Movement spells that trigger draw on each move work the same.
A unit pings my own unit for small damage, which sets off its wounded effect; a heal then restores its defence so it can be pinged and trigger again, holding the front cell.
Place a unit with a Death effect or a re-summon in the front row; a ping unit's small damage finishes it, so its Death effect fires and the pinger gains the kill.
